about: Measured facts about how this band model renders UI, tied to one firmware version (`firmware`). Every leaf is {value, status, source, date}: status "measured" (from a device photo or observation), "assumed" (from a spec, a font file or another model) or "unknown" (value null). Top level: `device` and `screen` (the panel itself, true for everything drawn on it). `quickapp`: how the Vela quick-app (JS app) renderer draws text, boxes, CSS, colour, images and animation. `face`: how the watch-face engine (band10-toolkit .bin faces: widgets, image lists, the Lua layer, always-on) draws; a different renderer, so quick-app facts never stand in for face facts. Layout code reads it through tools/vela-calib/profile.js (quick-app paths like 'font.line_box_em' resolve inside `quickapp`); tools/vela-calib/measure.py writes it from photos of the calibration app. Units: band px (= design px, designWidth = screen width) and em (x font-size).

firmware.note: Every measured fact here was measured on this firmware. After a firmware update, re-run the calibration kit (tools/vela-calib) and compare before trusting the profile; then bump this.

assumed.note: 2026-09-27 photos: every measured bold string is 0.79-1.07x the assumed table (letters 0.92-1.00, digits 0.79 ('1') to 1.03, '0 0 0 0' 1.07 because the space is 0.339 em, not 0.283). 1.1 still covers all of them. Digit strings run about 1 px per glyph wider than the table's em widths (0000: 65.0/127.7/250.2 px at 24/48/96 = 0.64 em + 1 px per glyph), so at small sizes the fixed px matters: at 16 px a digit string reaches ~1.10x.

measured.note: Widths measured at one size carry ~1 px per glyph of fixed tracking: a digit advance measured at 48 px (em + 1/48) under-reads at 24 px by ~0.02 em per glyph (3 %), over-reads at larger sizes. 1.02 covers sizes >= ~30 px; below that add 1 px per glyph.

advance_tracking.note: Fixed tracking in band px added per glyph for text under below_px, to glyphs whose advance is measured (and to every glyph of a string measured whole). Measured advances carry ~1 px per glyph that the em width doesn't scale; the 1.02 measured safety covers it from ~30 px up, not below. Assumed advances (x 1.1) already cover it: assumed letters measured 0.92-1.00 x the table, and 1 px at 26 px is <= 0.04 em. profile.js width() adds value x (tracked glyph count) when px < below_px.
